segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Returns the number of people in the image. private func countFaces(image: CIImage) async -> Int { // Approximate the number of people in the image. let request = VNDetectFaceRectanglesRequest() let requestHandler = VNImageRequestHandler(ciImage: image) do { try requestHandler.perform([request]) if let results = request.results { return results.count } } catch { print("Unable to perform face detection: \(error).") } return 0 } ```
